## Frequently asked questions

Everything about installing MCPs, supported clients, and pricing.

![](/pixel/crt-monitor.png)

### QWhat is an MCP server?

An MCP server is a process that implements the Model Context Protocol — an open standard from Anthropic that lets Claude, Cursor, Cline, and other AI clients securely call external tools and read external data. Most MCP servers are npm packages run via `npx -y`.

### QHow do I install an MCP server in Claude?

On Unyly, click Install on any MCP page, pick which clients to install into (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Cline), and we write the config files for you. No JSON editing, no terminal, no restart loop.

### QIs Unyly free?

Yes — browsing and few-click install are free forever. Pro tier unlocks hosted MCP servers, team installs, and private catalogs.

### QWhich clients does Unyly support?

Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Continue, and Windsurf — every major MCP-aware client. The same Install button writes the right config for whichever ones you have installed.

### QHow is Unyly different from mcp.so or PulseMCP?

mcp.so and PulseMCP are catalogs — you read about an MCP, then install it manually. Unyly installs it for you: click Install, confirm in your client, and the config is written across every MCP-aware client on your machine. Unyly also offers hosted servers and curated stacks.

### QCan I publish my own MCP on Unyly?

Yes — Submit your repo at /submit. We review it, list it in the catalog, and your MCP becomes installable in a couple of clicks for every Unyly user.

### QHow many MCP servers are on Unyly?

93,000+ Model Context Protocol servers, indexed from the official MCP registry, PulseMCP, npm crawls, and direct submissions. Updated every 6 hours.

### QIs it safe to install MCPs from Unyly?

Verified servers (badged with a checkmark) have passed security review. Community servers are auto-indexed but not vetted — install with the same caution as any npm package.
